findings.text: The replacement assertion at line 137 (`assert f"delivered {ticker.ARROW} in review" in drawn`) is not independent of the value under test. The painter's memory is seeded to 'delivered' at line 134, and Ticker.render (reckon/crew/ticker.py:2707) reads a stream row's left word from self._reported before the row's own from_state, so the assertion holds with the field this commit added removed: a read-only probe against the head sources rendered the same in-review row with its from_state key deleted and still printed 'delivered -> in review'. Removing reckon/crew/ticker.py:1558 would leave the test green, so the ticker change has no guard. The prior review found this same test's assertion satisfied by the grid's accumulated memory; the repair still draws from that memory rather than from the row alone.

The added `assert any(...)` block at lines 129-131 is not ruff-formatted. `ruff format --check` on the three staged source and test paths reports one file would be reformatted and the only hunk is this block, while the same file was format-clean at the reviewed base 220cc0042. The node's done-when requires that ruff check and ruff format --check add no findings on the staged paths against the base, so that clause is unmet by the repair round even though the ticker.py format finding the previous review recorded is now fixed.
